verdict.rationale: Atlas's own docs say it provides a registered agent to satisfy Delaware compliance requirements as part of its online incorporation flow, so the core service exists. Nothing shows it can be bought on its own for a change filing, or that the exact agent name and street address are delivered the same day. missing for 10: standalone online purchase of registered-agent service, support for change-of-agent filings, documented disclosure of the exact agent name and street address, same-day turnaround, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can buy registered-agent service online and get the exact agent name and street address my formation or change filing needs the same day

citations.quote: Satisfy Delaware compliance requirements with a registered agent.
